title: Limestone cube erosion study on the Smithsonian roof

tellings.quote: like they they took a one cube of freshly cut limestone and they put it on the roof of the Smithsonian Institution and then began to monitor its erosion over many decades.

plain: A freshly cut cube of limestone was once placed on the roof of the Smithsonian Institution, the US national museum in Washington, and its wearing away was measured over many decades. The researcher Randall Carlson describes this study without naming where it was published. He brings it up as a way to judge how fast stone erodes, and so how old weathered ancient stonework might be.
